title: ACEF v1.1 Transparency Disclosure Payload (overlay)
description: ACEF Core v1.1 overlay of transparency_disclosure. Inlines the v1.0 property set (kept backward-compatible) and adds conditional discriminator-keyed enforcement for the V4 'badge_state' variant per brief §4.4. The discriminator is /payload/variant = 'verification_badge' (this re-uses the v1.0 'variant' field, which under v1.0 carried values like 'publication_evidence'; the v1.1 addition is the new enum value 'verification_badge' plus its branch-required fields). Records that do NOT set /payload/variant or set it to a v1.0 value validate exactly as under v1.0. Records that set it to 'verification_badge' MUST satisfy the brief §4.4 payload field set: badge_id, subject_ref, page_state, integrity_state, evidence_chain_root_ref, freshness_state_ref — plus provisional_reason when page_state='provisional' and public_artifact_link when page_state is 'green' or 'provisional'.

variant.description: Discriminator for payload variants. v1.0 values include 'publication_evidence'; v1.1 adds 'verification_badge' (the V4 badge_state variant per brief §4.4).

intended_use.description: Intended use of the AI system as described in the disclosure.

prohibited_uses.description: Prohibited uses of the AI system.

risk_warnings.description: Risk warnings included in the disclosure.

interpretation_guidance.description: Guidance on how to interpret system outputs.

explanation_methods.description: Explanation methods available for system outputs.

confidence_indicators.description: How confidence or uncertainty is communicated in system outputs.

known_failure_modes.description: Known failure modes described in the disclosure.

out_of_scope_uses.description: Uses that are out of scope for the AI system.

summary_published.description: Whether the summary has been publicly published (publication_evidence variant).

publication_url.description: URL where the disclosure is published (publication_evidence variant).

publication_content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the published content (publication_evidence variant).

reporting_period.description: Reporting period covered by the disclosure.

badge_id.description: Identifier for the verification badge (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4).

subject_ref.description: URN reference to the ai_system or ai_model the badge is verifying (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4).

page_state.description: Public page state shown for the badge (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4 + §16.7). Independent of integrity_state.

integrity_state.description: Bundle integrity state underlying the badge (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4 + §16.7). Independent of page_state.

evidence_chain_root_ref.description: URN of the top-level evidence record the badge depends on (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4).

freshness_state_ref.description: URN of the most-recent coverage_cell freshness state the badge depends on (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4).

provisional_reason.description: Reason the badge is in 'provisional' state. REQUIRED when page_state='provisional' (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4).

public_artifact_link.description: Public URL to the artifact backing the badge. REQUIRED when page_state is 'green' or 'provisional' (verification_badge variant, V4 per brief §4.4).

allOf.$comment: VAL-VARIANT-003 conditional enforcement for the V4 badge_state variant. When /payload/variant is 'verification_badge', the brief §4.4 required-field set applies: badge_id, subject_ref, page_state, integrity_state, evidence_chain_root_ref, freshness_state_ref. When unset (or any other v1.0 variant value), no additional constraint is imposed.
VAL-VARIANT-003 conditional enforcement for the V4 provisional_reason rule (brief §4.4: provisional_reason REQUIRED when page_state='provisional').
VAL-VARIANT-003 conditional enforcement for the V4 public_artifact_link rule (brief §4.4: public_artifact_link REQUIRED when page_state in {green, provisional}).
